description: Search World Bank contract awards — which contracts were awarded under World Bank-financed development projects (300k+ award notices across developing countries). Filter by full-text keyword and/or country to see recently awarded goods, civil works, and consulting contracts, each with project, bid reference, procurement method, award publication date, and a public notice URL (the notice detail page names the awarded supplier). Newest first. Keyless.

limit.description: Number of awards to return (1-50). Default 10.

query.description: Full-text keyword, e.g. "bridge construction", "audit services", "medical equipment". Optional.

name: wb_procurement_awards
title: Wb Procurement Awards
